motion.method: per-exposure ePSF position fits (forced.measure_position, ramp policy)

epoch_means_fit.note: diagnostic: epoch means of parallax-corrected positions (epochs with >= 3 points)

variability.method: later epoch log-flux interpolated in wavelength at the earlier epoch's points (gap <= 1.5 bandwidths); dmag > 0 = fading; errors scaled by sqrt(chi2_red)

field_star_shifts.method: 15-sigma peaks in full-epoch co-adds (target track excluded), 2-D Gaussian centroids, matched within 1 px; median shift of each epoch relative to the last full epoch (grid is north-up)

criteria.name: proper-motion null test |mu| < 3 sigma
criteria.notes: RW Aur B (1.52 arcsec, PA 74 deg) is unresolved; the fitted motion points at PA 78 deg: the A+B photocentre moves toward B as A fades (variability-induced shift), see offsets_from_prediction

criteria.name: brightness change > 0.2 mag at > 5 sigma at matched wavelengths (first vs last epoch)
criteria.threshold: some detector: |weighted mean dmag| > 0.2 and |dmag|/err > 5 (err scaled by sqrt(chi2_red))
criteria.notes: all RW Aur points are saturated; compare with the Barnard's Star control (same method, non-variable star)
